evidence:
Workbook (read in memory via zipfile, .qc-cache/hireops-lessons-2026-10-08-r6/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx): 'Quality Checks' A54..D54 = 53 | F - the task as a whole | task_is_distinct_and_authored | 'The task reads as authored for this product, fits the suite's domain plan, and isn't a nouns-swapped clone of a sibling.' 'Internal Quality Checks' row 54 carries identical text; the package has no comments/threadedComments parts (only text-free drawings and persons.xml), so there is no further internal annotation for this row. Skill references/quality-checks.md ### 53: 'Compare against sibling task names and concepts. Defect: a nouns-swapped clone of a sibling - same flows, same criteria, renamed entities.' NEW_TASK_AUTHORING_CONTEXT.md:203: 'author distinct domain behavior. Do not make nouns-swapped clones.'

Authored for this product: task/instruction.md:1-13 is a first-person recruiting-team request ('the workspace our recruiting team lives in all day', 'I often move several candidates together', 'If a message arrives while I am reading further up, leave my place alone'). task/environment/instructions/hireops_rules.md is product-specific throughout: six stages Applied..Rejected (:43-44), interview places 1-50 (:28-29), reopen only to the rejected-from stage (:50-51), per-person unread (:158-161), seen semantics with the observer excluded (:171-173), candidate wording table (:191-198), candidate data exclusion (:200-203). task.toml:5-15 name/description/keywords/arena_slice 'recruiting-hiring-operations' and provenance 'Adapted from the supplied HireOps task as a recruiting workspace' agree with the brief. All 15 functional (hro_intake_restart..hro_candidate), 5 polish (hro_pol_*) and 5 visual (hro_vis_*) criterion ids are HireOps-prefixed; criteria text uses seeded HireOps people and facts (Priya Nair, Noor Haddad, Mei Lin, Rafael Costa; tests/scored/functional/judge.toml:29-60). tests/app_context.md:244-272 names HireOps, its ten accounts and its screens.

No sibling residue: grep over the whole frozen task for pellmoor, threadline, torquebay, colderwater, bazaar, docketlight, ridgeline, vacancy, funnel, northstar, gridforge, patchpad, boardloom, drawbill, oriel, coursemark, expenseflow, medledger, utilibill found nothing; 'panel' hits are only natural seed message text ('feedback from the panel') and UI/CSS class names.

Sibling comparison: the only other recruiting task in projects/ is projects/pellmoor-job-pipeline (grep for recruit|candidate|hiring over every instruction.md/task.toml). Its scope (instruction.md:1-15; hiring-rules.md) is interview panels of at least two scorers, 1-5 scores, assessment versions invalidated by panel changes, a d3 funnel derived from stage history, offer/hire capacity reservations, receipts and idempotent retries, and a batch-offer review flow; its criterion names (e.g. exact_derived_funnel, panel_change_invalidates_entire_assessment, successful_retry_replays_one_result, batch_review_is_readonly_and_exact) share no flow set with HireOps. HireOps centres on a shared live kanban board (manual within-stage order shared by all, stale-version 409 naming the colleague, optimistic move with put-back and focus retention, bulk any-stage move in board order, own-last-move undo invalidated by anyone's later touch, 15 s live updates preserving focus, draft and scroll) plus one recruiter-candidate conversation per application (30-message paging that keeps the reader's anchor, per-person unread, seen marks, per-user per-browser drafts surviving sign-out) and a candidate portal with candidate wording and data exclusion. Pellmoor has no conversations, candidate portal, undo, within-stage ordering or live updates; HireOps has no panels, scores, assessment versions, funnel or receipts. The overlap is limited to generic pipeline facts (no stage skipping, a capacity cap, an all-or-none multi-card action, an activity log), which is shared domain, not a renamed clone. Messaging sibling projects/threadline-chat is a Slack-style channel/thread/reaction workspace; HireOps conversations are application-bound staff-candidate threads with role-based participation, so not a clone either. Visual criterion naming (type/color/layout/hierarchy/consistency) follows the shared template pattern, which is permitted infrastructure reuse (NEW_TASK_AUTHORING_CONTEXT.md:203).

Lessons file patterns bearing on this row (handoffs/LESSONS_FROM_COLDERWATER_2026-10-08.md): lesson 12 (notes reading like an acceptance checklist, or telling the builder how to build for the grader) - the brief and rules are in the team's voice with reasons ('We're usually in the middle of something when an update lands' hireops_rules.md:127; 'Our servers don't always start Node from inside the app folder' :207; 'Candidates are outside the company' :200). A few status codes (401/403/404 :22-24, 409 :80) and the 30-message page are stated as team rules; they read as authored product policy rather than one-to-one criterion mirrors for this row's purpose (row 1/6 own the finer fairness question). app_context.md:274-276's modifier-key note is judge-facing, not builder-facing. Lesson 5's self-check sentence appears at instruction.md:13 adapted with HireOps-specific steps (two browsers, reject, bulk + undo, messages, reload); grep across projects shows no other instruction.md carries it, so it is not copied boilerplate signalling a clone. Lessons 7, 13, 15 and 16 concern other rows.

Adversarial attempts: (a) clone hypothesis - mapping HireOps criteria onto Pellmoor by noun swap (card->application, job->vacancy, interview places->openings) fails: hro_two_people, hro_undo, hro_moves ordering, hro_messaging, hro_drafts, hro_long_thread, hro_unread_seen, hro_candidate and the live/thread polish legs have no Pellmoor counterpart, and Pellmoor's panel/score/funnel/receipt criteria have none in HireOps. (b) A broken-app / conforming-alternative probe is not meaningful for this whole-task identity row; it grades no app behaviour.

Residual (why risk=true, P3): no suite domain-plan or assignment record exists in the workspace (searched for 'domain plan' and 'Deliverables Tracker' outside qc/runs; only general guidance in NEW_TASK_AUTHORING_CONTEXT.md). 'Fits the suite's domain plan' is therefore supported only by task.toml provenance ('the supplied HireOps task') and arena_slice, not by an assignment record. If Pellmoor and HireOps ship in the same suite slice, a portal reviewer could question two hiring-pipeline tasks; the evidence shows distinct mechanics, but the plan fit itself is unverified here.
suggested_fix: Optional: record the suite assignment/domain-plan entry for HireOps (and its relation to pellmoor-job-pipeline) in the QC record or provenance so the plan fit is evidenced rather than inferred. No task change required.
